label: D2: reached S2 via a2 (common) after an unrewarded trial that did not end in S2
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and essentially only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S2 (common), on a trial whose D1 showed no reward (prev_reward == 0). That conjunction alone has recall ~1.0 and mass recall ~1.0 but precision 0.58 (dev F1 0.73). Adding that the previous trial did not reach S2 (prev_state == 1, or unknown at the window start) raises precision to 0.71 at mass recall 0.92 (dev F1 0.76); the recorded predicate. Cases where the previous trial was an unrewarded S2 visit fire weakly (8% of mass). Magnitude: top-quartile activations are over-represented when the previous trial was a1->S1 unrewarded (a switch to a2), and the very top examples follow a2->S1 rare unrewarded trials; i.e. it is strongest when S2 is reached freshly after a failure elsewhere. Never fires at S1, after a rewarded D1, or on rare transitions. All variables are observed at D2.
